note: No fact: the Code des personnes et de la famille (committee text, August 2025; excerpt ending at the head of Title IV chapter IV) concerns civil status. Its term hits are officers of police judiciaire as persons entitled to consult civil-status registers and obtain copies, fingerprints of declarants who cannot sign, and prosecutors' proces-verbaux on register deposits. It names a national digital civil-status register, which is outside the police field, and no police information system or station record.
